result.notes: fs=2000 Hz, N=8192 (4.096 s). Hann window + 8x zero-padded FFT (0.0305 Hz bins) with log-parabolic interpolation gives dominant peak at 49.9998 Hz with 2nd harmonic ~120 Hz; max magnitude in 55-65 Hz band is only 0.34% of global peak; pwelch peak also ~50 Hz. Data supports a 50 Hz dominant frequency, so the claimed 60 Hz is refuted.
